material_event.scope: NEXUS Build Verification now also triggers on pushes to main

superseded_continuity_pr.reason: base 7b2e690eecef70dc245c8013372e399da89d7349 became stale after PR #263 merged

lessons: Exact-head PR CI and exact-main push evidence are distinct claims.
A continuity snapshot based on a superseded main must be closed unmerged and replayed from exact current main.
Adding a main push trigger improves observability but does not by itself prove production readiness, rollback, disaster recovery, signing, or release authority.
